extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed Quest KACE (formerly Dell KACE) KBox 1000 agent version, or "Not installed".
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Quest KACE Agent Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
versionFile="/Library/Application Support/Dell/KACE/data/version" [[ ! -f "$versionFile" ]] && versionFile="/Library/Application Support/Quest/KACE/data/version"
if [[ -f "$versionFile" ]]; then version=$(/usr/bin/head -n1 "$versionFile") echo "<result>${version:-Unknown}</result>" else echo "<result>Not installed</result>" fi
